column1: # Generic A/B OTA layout for boards with 8 MB flash (Elecrow CrowPanel 5.79"
# partitions_ota.csv ends at 0x830000 and needs a 16 MB part. Here each slot
# is 3.875 MiB and the core dump follows them
# NVS stays at 0x9000/0x6000 to match every other Tesserae layout: a reflash
# that skips it keeps Wi-Fi credentials and the server registration
# webflasher's offset-addressed `parts` rely on that address.
